name: agent-cms
description: File-based CMS prototype for agents (no database)
author: Agent CMS

scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p public/vendor public/vendor/fancybox public/shell/vendor/loaders public/shell/vendor/utils && cp node_modules/markdown-it/dist/markdown-it.min.js public/vendor/markdown-it.min.js && cp node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js public/vendor/mermaid.min.js && cp node_modules/@toast-ui/editor/dist/toastui-editor.css public/vendor/toastui-editor.css && cp node_modules/mammoth/mammoth.browser.min.js public/vendor/mammoth.browser.min.js && cp node_modules/xlsx/dist/xlsx.full.min.js public/vendor/xlsx.full.min.js && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.js public/shell/vendor/three.module.js && cp node_modules/three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js public/shell/vendor/loaders/GLTFLoader.js && cp node_modules/three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js public/shell/vendor/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js && curl -fsSL https://uicdn.toast.com/editor/3.2.2/toastui-editor-all.min.js -o public/vendor/toastui-editor-all.min.js && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/highlightjs/cdn-release@11.11.1/build/highlight.min.js -o public/vendor/highlight.min.js && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/highlightjs/cdn-release@11.11.1/build/styles/github.min.css -o public/vendor/highlight-github.min.css && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fancyapps/ui@5.0.36/dist/fancybox/fancybox.css -o public/vendor/fancybox/fancybox.css && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fancyapps/ui@5.0.36/dist/fancybox/fancybox.umd.js -o public/vendor/fancybox/fancybox.umd.js
scripts.shell:pack: npm run pack --prefix desktop/agent-shell && node scripts/flatten-desktop-dist.js agent-shell
scripts.shell:dist: npm run dist --prefix desktop/agent-shell && node scripts/flatten-desktop-dist.js agent-shell
